papers.title: Parallel Bayesian Global Optimization of Expensive Functions
papers.abstract: We consider parallel global optimization of derivative-free expensive-to-evaluate functions, and propose an efficient method based on stochastic approximation for implementing a conceptual Bayesian optimization algorithm proposed by Ginsbourger et al. (2007). At the heart of this algorithm is maximizing the information criterion called the "multi-points expected improvement'', or the q-EI. To accomplish this, we use infinitessimal perturbation analysis (IPA) to construct a stochastic gradient estimator and show that this estimator is unbiased. We also show that the stochastic gradient ascent algorithm using the constructed gradient estimator converges to a stationary point of the q-EI surface, and therefore, as the number of multiple starts of the gradient ascent algorithm and the number of steps for each start grow large, the one-step Bayes optimal set of points is recovered. We show in numerical experiments that our method for maximizing the q-EI is faster than methods based on closed-form evaluation using high-dimensional integration, when considering many parallel function evaluations, and is comparable in speed when considering few. We also show that the resulting one-step Bayes optimal algorithm for parallel global optimization finds high-quality solutions with fewer evaluations than a heuristic based on approximately maximizing the q-EI. A high-quality open source implementation of this algorithm is available in the open source Metrics Optimization Engine (MOE).

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的并行贝叶斯优化方法可迁移至昂贵仿真（如FEA）的采样效率优化，但未涉及生物力学约束或植入物设计。
llm.why_not_core: Does not handle constraints beyond single-objective, lacks explicit uncertainty quantification tailored to surrogate reliability, and has no validation on implant or biomechanics problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高昂贵黑箱函数并行全局优化的效率
summary_zh.method: 使用无穷小扰动分析构建随机梯度，最大化多点期望改进准则
summary_zh.result: 方法比基于高维积分更快，且用更少评估找到高质量解
summary_zh.validation: 在标准数值测试函数上进行实验验证

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently optimize expensive black-box functions by enabling parallel function evaluations.
summary_en.method: Uses infinitesimal perturbation analysis to construct unbiased stochastic gradients for maximizing multi-point expected improvement (q-EI).
summary_en.result: The proposed method is faster than closed-form high-dimensional integration and achieves high-quality solutions with fewer evaluations.
summary_en.validation: Validated on standard numerical benchmark functions, demonstrating speed and solution quality advantages.

papers.title: The effect of total hip arthroplasty on sagittal spinal–pelvic–leg alignment and low back pain in patients with severe hip osteoarthritis
papers.first_author_affiliation: Department of Joint Surgery, The Affiliated Drum Tower Hospital of Nanjing University Medical School, Nanjing, China

corresponding_authors.name: Wenjie Weng
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Joint Surgery, The Affiliated Drum Tower Hospital of Nanjing University Medical School, Nanjing, China

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究全髋关节置换术对脊柱-骨盆-下肢力线和下腰痛的影响，属于临床结果研究，未涉及植入物力学或有限元分析。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not quantify femoral stress shielding, micromotion, or use any FEA/contact modeling; it is purely a clinical outcomes study without biomechanical or implant design focus.

summary_zh.motivation: 探究全髋关节置换术对脊柱-骨盆-下肢力线和下腰痛的影响。
summary_zh.method: 前瞻性临床研究，测量术前术后影像学参数和疼痛评分。
summary_zh.result: 置换术后脊柱-骨盆参数改善，下腰痛减轻。
summary_zh.validation: 临床患者前后对照研究。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effect of total hip arthroplasty on sagittal spinal-pelvic-leg alignment and low back pain in patients with severe hip osteoarthritis.
summary_en.method: Prospective clinical study with radiographic measurements and pain scoring before and after surgery.
summary_en.result: Postoperative improvements in spinal-pelvic parameters and reduction in low back pain were observed.
summary_en.validation: Clinical pre-post comparison in a patient cohort.
